order_rule: Sort episode IDs by SHA256(UTF8(seed + colon + decimal pass + colon + decimal episode)), then episode ID; use the same order for every arm and phase. Rotate arms left by pass modulo four.

bootstrap.family_sampling: 32 families with replacement from each of four fixed cells
bootstrap.generator: xorshift32 with rejection sampling for bounded integers

primary.checks: Geometric mean of paired family sums over the four measured views; one stable result per view.
primary.cpu: Geometric mean of paired whole-worker CPU ratios across 12 passes, including model loading, warmup, measured work and receipt output.
primary.pass_rule: For each reference: CPU point ratio <= 0.95 and CPU upper bound < 1; verifier-check upper bound < 1. All answers and stable replays verify.
primary.scope: This frozen machine and roster; pass resampling describes variation within this run. Family resampling keeps the four views together and the four cells balanced.
primary.secondary: Report every arm, per-cell checks, CPU and wall cost, peak memory, setup, controller and independent-check costs. Keep failures and incomplete runs separate from a complete primary decision.
